children: US thrombectomy device maker's Q3 revenue rose 15.6%, beating analyst expectations
Net income for Q3 declined year-over-year
Company will not provide financial guidance for full year 2026 due to pending acquisition
THROMBECTOMY GROWTH - Global thrombectomy revenue rose 18.1% year-over-year, with U.S. venous thromboembolism revenue up 26%
EMBOLIZATION AND ACCESS - Global embolization and access revenue increased 10.8% year-over-year
U.S. NEURO REVENUE - U.S. neuro revenue grew 19.3% from a year earlier
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the medical equipment, supplies & distribution peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Penumbra, Inc. is $374.00, about 17.5% above its October 28 closing price of $318.31
The stock recently traded at 55 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 56 three months ago
